Proposed sequence (total 4.5 hours including breaks + debriefs):
- 09:00–09:15 — Intro / kickoff (Neha) — 15 min
- 09:15–10:00 — System design (Vivek) — 45 min
- 10:05–10:35 — Take-home walkthrough / code discussion (Aditya) — 30 min
- 10:35–10:50 — BREAK — 15 min
- 10:50–11:20 — Deep dive / algorithms (Hannah) — 30 min
- 11:25–11:50 — Product + cross-team questions (Laura) — 25 min
- 11:50–12:10 — Candidate Q&A + close (Neha) — 20 min
- 12:10–12:40 — Panel debrief (internal only) — 30 min

Notes / asks:
- I added 5-minute buffers between technical blocks to transition and ensure Zoom re-entries are smooth. If you need more change the slot and call it out.
- Attached: candidate resume, draft agenda, evaluation rubric.
- Emma: please confirm candidate's final time-zone and whether she needs any accommodation. Also share the final calendar invite to Samantha after we lock it.

If you see any conflicts, reply with proposed swaps (I can coordinate reorder — e.g., swap System design / Algorithms).

Thanks — Neha
